verdict.rationale: Puzzle's API getting-started docs describe a sandbox server (staging.southparkdata.com) that is separate from the production server (api.puzzle.io), with dedicated test credentials. That lets developers test without touching production data. Credentials are issued manually by email, not self-serve, and the sandbox runs on a non-puzzle.io staging domain. Missing for 10: self-serve sandbox provisioning, documentation of sandbox data seeding/reset behavior, a sandbox mode for the MCP/agent surface, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Sandbox Server: https://staging.southparkdata.com / Production Server: https://api.puzzle.io
